name: Standard Energy Solutions
old_description: Standard Energy Solutions is a premier renewable energy contractor in the Mid-Atlantic region.  Since 2004, our team has been on the leading edge of renewable energy innovation allowing us to design and install the highest quality renewable energy solutions for our customers.
about:
Founded in 2004 and headquartered in Columbia, Maryland, Standard Energy Solutions operates as a renewable energy contractor serving the Mid-Atlantic region. The company began with a focus on designing and installing solar photovoltaic and battery storage systems for residential customers.

The firm provides end-to-end solar installation services, including system design using high-efficiency modules, engineering, permitting, utility interconnection, and installation scheduling. Through its Premier Partner program, it supports independent dealers with proposal design, financing options (loans, leases, PPAs, cash), and a proprietary project management platform that tracks each project from sale to commissioning. To date, the company has installed more than 8,000 residential solar and battery systems, totaling over 89.6 megawatts of solar capacity across six states.

Standard Energy Solutions primarily serves residential homeowners through a network of certified dealer partners. Its Premier Partner program targets solar sales organizations that want to outsource design, permitting, and installation while retaining the customer relationship. The company also works directly with homeowners seeking service or maintenance on existing systems.

The company emphasizes speed and transparency: it offers a 20-day installation completion guarantee for qualified projects, weekly commission payments to partners upon project funding, and 25-year comprehensive product and production warranties. Its proprietary project management system provides automated status updates and weekly review meetings to keep projects on schedule.
